policy_contract: FROZEN policy only: v29-iso4 chain (ResidualTemporalValue seeds 1729/1730/1731, fold 10, width 48, dropout 0.15) + frozen iso2/iso4/isoall calibrators (2025-12-01 vintage) + majority/confirmed votes + frequency cap 4/month + cooldown 5d. NO threshold/architecture/frequency/ensemble changes. NO injected confidence: decision dicts never carry a confidence field; WAIT stays WAIT and is never mapped to SHORT/FLAT to force signals.

frozen_reference.chain: closed 5m -> SwingStore.sample (5 TF x 128 closed bars) -> encode_windows + feat40/ATR -> 3 checkpoints -> combine penalty 0.0 -> frozen iso maps -> choose() per map -> majority/confirmed vote -> frequency cap4/cd5 (iso4 geometry)
frozen_reference.anchor_rule: decision bars are closed 5m bars with open_time on the 6h UTC grid (00/06/12/18); stride 72 bars (6h). STABLE UTC grid derived from open_time, never a positional-index modulo.
frozen_reference.note: Stride is read from THIS config (72) and cross-checked against the W1 prespec anchor (36864 % 72 == 0). Any mismatch fails closed.

gates.rule: Chronological: skip unless vote passes AND action non-WAIT AND decision_time >= next_allowed AND monthly count < cap. Same verbatim rule for BOTH the iso4-only gate (independent counters) and the confirmed gate (independent counters).
gates.control_gate: iso4 raw non-WAIT actions only, fixed 1x, independent counters
gates.operating_gate: confirmed-vote non-WAIT actions only, independent counters

execution.engine: ohlc-v2 (src/agentic_alpha_lab/backtest/engine.py) via scripts/opencode_r76_feedexec.py FeedExecAccount (imported, NOT reimplemented)
execution.entry: next-bar: entry sought strictly on bars > signal_bar, window signal+1..signal+entry_expiry_bars, then CANCEL expired
execution.tp_rule: TP1 50% partial exit FIRST, remainder runs to TP2
execution.entry_bar_suppression: targets suppressed on the intrabar entry candle unless entered at/through the open (engine ohlc-v2)
execution.timeout: exit at the timeout bar open (funding charged first if funding time); reason time_after_tp1 iff TP1 done else time
execution.truncated_window: replay with known horizon rejects entries whose entry+holding exceeds the horizon (TRUNCATED); fresh open-ended mode has no truncation (n_bars=None)

costs.note: Stop/timeout exits are market-like at the scenario fee, NOT guaranteed maker/limit fills.

control_account.name: iso4_only_1x
control_account.rule: Evolves on EVERY eligible iso4 raw decision (own independent frequency gate + own busy state) even when operating abstains, is busy, halted or tripped. Fixed 1x always. Baseline 1x evaluation, separate from DD/operational overlays.
control_account.causality: DD sizing (guard) reads ONLY independently-realized control exits with exit_time strictly before the operating decision_time. Same-bar control exits are posted to the guard AFTER the operating intake of that bar.

guard.name: dd_guard
guard.reference: scripts/opencode_risk_overlay_probe.py:47-61. Reuses v1.DdGuard code UNMODIFIED; exits posted are control-account realized exits only.

overlays.status: NOT part of the historical reference policy. Versioned here explicitly; batch (replay) and streaming (fresh) both execute through the SAME AdvisorStrategy class, so the same rules apply in both modes by construction (never described as bit-identical to confirmed_dd_guard).

daily_halt.rule: UTC-day loss >= 3% halts NEW operating intents for the rest of the day; open positions still settle. Reuses v2.DailyLossHalt UNMODIFIED.

divergence.rule: UNDER-only 5% trip of operating equity vs causal control realized equity (past-only forward-fill); latched; blocks NEW operating intents. Reuses v2.1 OneSidedDivergenceMonitor.check() UNMODIFIED via r76 ControlDivergenceTrip (expected_at repointed to causal control trace).

max_position.rule: max_positions=1 asserted fail-closed on each account separately. Reuses v2.MaxPositionGuard.blocks_new_intent() UNMODIFIED.

feed.auth: none - public market-data GET only, no keys, no orders
feed.forming_candle: dropped - only closed candles (close_time <= now) ingested
feed.status_note: WARMUP (insufficient history) is distinct from WAIT (model abstain on a grid bar), OFF_CLOCK (closed bar off the 6h grid, settled only), STALE/DUPLICATE/OUT_OF_ORDER/INCOMPLETE/MARKET_MISMATCH (feed rejects), DIAGNOSTIC (pre-observation inference, never actionable), READINESS_ERROR (fail-closed, names the file). Every status record carries observed_at; decision rows also carry decision_time.

fresh_pagination.direction: backwards from now via endTime paging

state.identity_policy: resume rejects ANY identity change (names the field).
